acceptance_criteria.description: Users must authenticate with valid credentials before they can access any application page.
kane_steps: Open the application base URL without being logged in
Attempt to access a protected page directly
Verify the user is prompted to log in or blocked from viewing the page

acceptance_criteria.description: After logging in with valid credentials, the user is redirected to the product inventory page.
kane_steps: Navigate to the login page
Enter username standard_user and password secret_sauce
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the product inventory page

acceptance_criteria.description: The product inventory page displays product tiles that include each product's name, image, and price.
kane_steps: Log in with valid credentials
View the product inventory page
Verify each visible product tile shows a name, image, and price
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Inventory tiles show name image price

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can open a product's detail page by clicking its name or image on the inventory page.
kane_steps: Log in and open the product inventory page
Click a product name on a product tile
Verify the product detail page opens for that product
Return to inventory and click the same product's image
Verify the product detail page opens again
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Click name or image opens details

acceptance_criteria.description: The product detail page displays the product name, description, price, and an Add to cart button.
kane_steps: Log in and open a product detail page
Verify the product name is displayed
Verify the description, price, and Add to cart button are displayed
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Detail page shows full product info

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can add a product to the cart from the inventory page using the Add to cart button.
kane_steps: Log in and open the product inventory page
Click Add to cart on a product that is not yet in the cart
Verify the product is added to the cart
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Add product to cart from inventory

acceptance_criteria.description: After adding a product from the inventory page, the Add to cart button label changes to Remove.
kane_steps: Log in and open the product inventory page
Click Add to cart on a product
Verify the button label on that product changes to Remove
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Add to cart button becomes Remove

acceptance_criteria.description: After adding a product to the cart, the cart badge in the top navigation updates to show the current number of items in the cart.
kane_steps: Log in and note the cart badge count
Add a product to the cart from the inventory page
Verify the cart badge count increases to reflect the number of items in the cart

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can remove a product from the cart on the inventory page by clicking the Remove button.
kane_steps: Log in and add a product to the cart from the inventory page
Click Remove on that product
Verify the product is removed from the cart
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Remove product from cart on inventory

acceptance_criteria.description: After removing a product on the inventory page, the button label changes back to Add to cart.
kane_steps: Log in and add a product to the cart from the inventory page
Click Remove on that product
Verify the button label changes back to Add to cart

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can navigate to the cart page at /cart.html.
kane_steps: Log in to the application
Navigate to /cart.html
Verify the cart page loads successfully

acceptance_criteria.description: The cart page lists all added items with their name, quantity, and price.
kane_steps: Log in and add one or more products to the cart
Open the cart page
Verify each added item is listed with its name, quantity, and price

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can sort products using the sort dropdown in the top right of the inventory page.
kane_steps: Log in and open the product inventory page
Locate the sort dropdown in the top right
Select a sort option
Verify the product list order updates accordingly

acceptance_criteria.description: The sort dropdown provides all four sort options: Name (A to Z), Name (Z to A), Price (low to high), and Price (high to low).
kane_steps: Log in and open the product inventory page
Open the sort dropdown
Verify Name (A to Z), Name (Z to A), Price (low to high), and Price (high to low) are available

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting Price (low to high) displays the cheapest product first, with Sauce Labs Onesie at $7.99 shown first.
kane_steps: Log in and open the product inventory page
Select Price (low to high) from the sort dropdown
Verify Sauce Labs Onesie at $7.99 is the first product shown
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Low to high sorts Onesie first

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting Name (A to Z) displays Sauce Labs Backpack as the first product in the list.
kane_steps: Log in and open the product inventory page
Select Name (A to Z) from the sort dropdown
Verify Sauce Labs Backpack is the first product shown
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: A to Z sorts Backpack first
